svg.title: Review an OpenCode test-file proposal in Jupyter AI on CPD
svg.desc: 1: Check the proposed file is inside the practice workspace. 2: Review independently derived expected answers in the proposed diff. 3: Allow once approves this one request; Reject declines it. 4: Read the selected agent, CPD Qwen model and current mode.
